children: SIS Limited, a provider of security, facility management and cash logistics solutions, has acquired an additional 1.51% stake in Updater Services, a Chennai-headquartered integrated facilities management company, through open-market transactions on September 3.
Updater Services shares appeared to react to the transaction, soaring 2.23% to Rs 236.61 amid heavy volumes and extending their uptrend for the fifth consecutive session.
According to bulk deal data, SIS bought 10.12 lakh shares, representing a 1.51% stake in Updater Services, for Rs 23.76 crore at a price of Rs 234.59 per share.
In the current quarter, SIS has acquired 21.92 lakh shares, or a 3.27% stake, in Updater Services, in addition to its 4.88% shareholding as of June 2026.
Taurus MF sells over 1% stake in Advit Jewels

Taurus Mutual Fund Flexicap Share Multi Cap sold 4.82 lakh shares, representing a 1.05% stake in Advit Jewels, a manufacturer of handcrafted fine jewellery under the brand name Rambhaj, for Rs 11.63 crore at a price of Rs 241 per share.
However, Ramesh Sawalram Saraogi bought 5 lakh shares, representing a 1.09% stake in Advit Jewels, for Rs 12.14 crore at a price of Rs 242.92 per share.
Alpa Wealth Creator sells 1.84% stake in KSR Footwear
Alpa Wealth Creator sold 3.38 lakh shares, equivalent to a 1.84% stake in KSR Footwear, for Rs 1.06 crore at a price of Rs 31.43 per share.
However, Ranu Parwal HUF bought 1.5 lakh shares in KSR Footwear for Rs 46.8 lakh, while Indra Investment acquired 1.5 lakh shares for Rs 47.38 lakh.
KSR Footwear shares rallied 7% to Rs 31.54 amid heavy volumes on the NSE.
Chanakya Opportunities Fund buys additional 1.43% stake in Bulkcorp International

Chanakya Opportunities Fund I acquired an additional 1.08 lakh shares, representing a 1.43% stake in packaging solutions provider Bulkcorp International, at Rs 75.59 per share, valued at Rs 81.63 lakh.
However, Care Wealth Advisors LLP exited Bulkcorp by selling all 91,200 shares, representing a 1.21% stake, for Rs 68.94 lakh at Rs 75.60 per share.
As of March 2026, Chanakya Opportunities Fund held a 5.04% stake in Bulkcorp.
Bulkcorp shares were locked in a 5% upper circuit at Rs 75.60 amid heavy volumes on the NSE.

title: SIS buys additional 1.51% stake in Updater Services; Taurus MF sells over 1% stake in Advit Jewels
